notes: Columbia Business School Doctoral Program 'Dissertations' pages (dissertations?year=2002..2007), Common Crawl captures from 2015, 2016 and 2017. Each entry gives a dissertation title, 'Name, YEAR' and a Faculty Advisor; the page does not state whether the year is the dissertation/degree year, so yearMeaning is 'unstated' (the page is a dissertation listing, so the year is most plausibly the dissertation completion year, but it is not labelled). No department, degree, placement or position is given per person; degree is left null although the page sits under the Doctoral Program section. Every snapshot of the 2002, 2003, 2004, 2006 and 2007 pages shows exactly 10 entries and the ordering differs between captures, so each capture appears to be only the first page of a paginated list (the 2005 page shows the same 8 people in both captures and may be complete); different captures show partly different people (for example, Woodrow Tyler Johnson and Eric Mitchell Jackson appear only in the 2017 capture of the 2002 page; Daniel Tobias Dorn, Natalia Gershun, Jaehoon Hahn and Bin Yu only in the 2016 capture of the 2003 page; Jorg Rocholl, Milena Todorova, Min Wei and Yong Keun Yoo only in the 2016 capture of the 2004 page; Thanavut Pornrojnangkool and Emily Amanatullah only in the 2016 capture of the 2007 page while Stav Gaon appears only in the 2015 capture). The full year lists are therefore likely incomplete. Dissertation titles are copied as written, including the 2007 title with broken spacing ('Inform ation C ontents'). Operations-relevant entries include Ben Wang (advisor Sergei V. Savin, 2003), Gustavo Jose Vulcano (van Ryzin, 2003), Roy Mashal (Zeevi, 2004), Carlo Marinelli (de la Pena, 2004), Milena Todorova (Broadie, 2004), Joern Meissner (Federgruen, 2005), Srinivas Krishnamoorthy (Gallego, 2005), Qian Liu (van Ryzin, 2006), Nan Yang (Federgruen, 2007) and Ashish Jain (Broadie, 2007); the page does not state departments, so this is the reader's flag, not page content.
